name: Ranger Phoenix Plumes: 5-Advantage Skullpiercer and Woodland Arrow summon a War Falcon and restore Focus (#480)
contract: Phoenix Plumes 705074 (Ranger Survival talent, CharacterAdvancement 34179) reads 'Your Skullpiercers and Woodland Arrows used with 5 stacks of Advantage now restore $520784s3% Focus and summon a War Falcon for $520558d.' The talent record itself is two SPELL_AURA_DUMMY effects with ProcFlags 0 and no class mask, so nothing in Spell.dbc or the world DB acts on it. Its helper 520558 'Phoenix Plumes' carries exactly the promised payload: effect 0 SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON of creature 50393 'War Falcon' (SummonProperties 61, a guardian) at TARGET_DEST_TARGET_BACK, DurationIndex 32 = 6000 ms ($520558d = 6 sec), and effect 1 SPELL_EFFECT_ENERGIZE_PCT on the caster, MiscValue 2 (Focus), BasePoints 2 + DieSides 1 = 3%, the same 3 as $520784s3. 520567 'Phoenix Plumes' is its client-side trigger (SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL 520558). Skullpiercer is rank chain 802036 (501715-501723) and Woodland Arrow is chain 806368 (806444-806448, 572579); both are Advantage consumers (CasterAuraSpell 804329, Advantage StackAmount 5). The Ranger uses the bow-requiring Skullpiercer (EquippedItemClass 2, subclass mask bows/crossbows, instant) and Woodland Arrow (no weapon requirement, 2 s cast, 5-30 yd), so the fixture carries Worn Shortbow 2504, faces +X with the Harvest Golem 15 yd ahead and has ranged hit fixed so the consumer lands. The control spends 4 Advantage: no falcon and no Phoenix Plumes energize. With 5 Advantage each ability must leave exactly one War Falcon owned by the Ranger and one 520558 energize log; the falcon must be gone after its 6 s. Before the fix both 5-stack assertions read 0.
